title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundation model, is about to have […]

title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

title: Tressfecta wants to make hair braiding a less arduous task for hairstylists
summary: Tressfecta builds products for textured hair. Its first project is a tool called Plait Pilot that helps braiders with the initial process of separating hair from packs before braiding begins.

title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
summary: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.

title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
summary: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

title: And the winner of Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026 is: Intero Biosystems
summary: Intero Biosystems beat out 199 other Startup Battlefield companies to take home the $100,000 grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

title: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends October 16
summary: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit. These savings for Founder and Investor Passes vanish after Friday. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station. Bring your toughest questions and make the day count for your business.

title: Ramp reaches $60B valuation as it pushes deeper into AI
summary: The funding comes as Ramp's annualized revenue crosses $2B, and its customer count reaches 85,000.

title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Last day
summary: Last day to be part of TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Join 10,000+ tech leaders for a day of connections and insights. Save 75% on your pass now.

title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
summary: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.

title: Meet the five companies competing in the Startup Battlefield finals at Disrupt 2026
summary: It’s time to unveil the five companies that will be competing in the Startup Battlefield finals.

title: Gudea leverages AI to help organizations prevent social media crises before they erupt
summary: Gudea, a company that tracks how stories and rumors spread online that describes itself as the “storm tracker for the internet,” is using AI to help organizations spot trouble brewing online before it turns into a crisis.

title: Intero Biosystems wants drugmakers to test on mini human intestines, not animals
summary: Intero Biosystems is selling lab-grown human intestines to drugmakers as regulators push for alternatives to animal testing, while the startup looks to scale production and expand its organoid technology.

title: CedarDB wants one database to handle both transactions and analytics, as AI agents raise the stakes
summary: Databases have traditionally been designed either for analytical data or for operational data. But database engine CedarDB supports both, and its approach has gained relevance with the rise of agentic AI.

title: Colossal Biosciences announces new AI platform to help accelerate de-extinction efforts
summary: Colossal announced a new AI platform to help accelerate its de-extinction efforts and Peter Diamandis has launched a new fund to back startups who use it.

title: TimeTeller puts our internal clocks at the center of personalized medicine
summary: German startup TimeTeller has developed a saliva test kit to help anyone understand their circadian rhythm; it aims to reduce side effects from cancer treatments.

title: Hiyd is a health tracker that attaches to the watch you already wear
summary: Former Apple engineers figured out how to get a biometric sensor to attach to your watch without any magnets or adhesives.

title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
summary: Most companies use AI agents to ship products faster or speed up workflows. Apate.ai sends them undercover to get scammed.

title: Mosqitter is turning its mosquito traps into an AI-powered surveillance network
summary: Mosqitter is turning its mosquito-trapping hardware into an AI-powered surveillance network designed to identify species, monitor populations, and provide earlier warnings of mosquito-borne disease risks.

title: Prismm helps banks keep inherited money in-house
summary: With Prismm, account holders can give designated family members access to their accounts and documents ahead of time.
